text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending the installation of speed humps on Charlottetown Boulevard, between Conference Boulevard and Lawrence Avenue East. Staff's assessment indicates that the criteria as set out in the updated Traffic Calming Policy has been satisfied. Therefore, speed humps should be installed on Charlottetown Boulevard.
The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Deferred consideration of the item until the September 19, 2024 meeting of the Scarborough Community Council.
